heading_152.action_argument_source: Ref/GameMode.cpp:17157-17170 (ProcessTalkType @0x578f10) computes v79 from yaw and calls CMode::SendMsg(this,152,v79,0,0).
heading_152.selected_action_value: The action computes (int(yaw)+180)/45 using signed arithmetic and masks with 0x80000007; for negative quotient it jumps to normalization `(((byte)value - 1) | 0xfffffff8) + 1`. The 152 send arm itself does not apply &7: it truncates val1 into the packet direction byte. Thus the selected source normalization is upstream in the /bangbang action.
